text:
sara: Hey team - customer reported that the Console metrics keep showing global counts even when they select region=eu-west + model=lama-v2 + version=v1.3. They're seeing 0 tokens in the UI but API logs show successful calls. Escalating P1. :rotating_light:
sara: Repro steps from the customer: 1) Open Console -> Usage 2) Set Region = eu-west 3) Model = lama-v2 (alias present) 4) Version = v1.3 5) Observe graph at 0 for the time window (last 24h) — but API shows ~120k tokens.
sara: They attached the raw API event for one hit: ```{"req_id":"r_9a8b7c","model":"lama-v2","model_alias":"lama-latest","model_version":"v1.3","region":"eu-west","tokens":512}```
kevin: Thanks Sara. Can you paste the Console query (or time range) they used? Also need one example request_id and the exact timestamp of the API call so we can correlate with ingestion. :eyes:
sara: Time range last 24h, customer sent sample req_id r_9a8b7c at 2026-03-15T11:22:14Z. Attached screenshot link: https://redwood.s3/esc/1801234567-screenshot.png
matt: Quick check — are we sure the ingestion pipeline tagged both model_version and model_alias? I remember we made a change to prefer alias for routing, maybe analytics normalized differently.
infra-bot: Alert: analytics-ingest service reported a partial parsing error for events containing both model_alias and model_version between 2026-03-15T00:00:00Z and 2026-03-16T02:00:00Z. Error rate spike +0.8%.
kevin: That matches. I can reproduce locally: when event contains model_alias we accidentally collapse the model_version into a freeform "model" tag and the metrics query uses the column model_version IS NOT NULL filter which fails. SQL example of problematic query: ```SELECT sum(tokens) FROM usage_events WHERE region='eu-west' AND model='lama-v2' AND model_version='v1.3' GROUP BY time(1h);``` In ingestion we ended up populating model='lama-latest' and model_version=NULL for aliased events.
sara: Ugh. So UI filter is looking at model_version but the data shows version on alias only. Customer lost visibility.
kevin: Root cause: a normalization step in analytics-ingest (commit 3f4a2) preferred alias as canonical model name and nulled out model_version for aliased payloads. I have a patch that keeps model_version intact and writes both canonical_model + model_version columns. PR: https://git.redwood/eng/analytics/pull/472
kevin: I'll canary the fix to prod-ingest in two EU shards and reprocess the backlog for the affected window. Canary ETA 30m, full roll 2h, backfill job ~3h.
sara: Noted. I'll update the customer with the timeline and mark this P1. Any chance we can surface partial counts until backfill?
matt: We can add a temporary UI fallback to treat model filter as matching either canonical_model or model_alias, but that's a frontend change. Quick workaround: run an ad-hoc query in the Console "Advanced" SQL and query by model_alias. Support can share the query.
sara: Customer okay with timeline. Please post when canary finishes and when backfill completes.
infra-bot: Canary rollout started on prod-ingest-eu-1 at 1801234740. Monitoring: ingestion-error-rate down to baseline.
kevin: Canary looks good. Rolling to prod-ingest-eu-*. Backfill job started: job_id bf_20260315_01. Progress: 0% -> 12% (first shard).
support-bot: Notifying customer: "We identified an ingestion normalization bug that affected aliased models; we have a fix in progress and are backfilling the last 26 hours of events. Expect metrics to appear within ~4 hours. Apologies for the disruption." :pray:
sara: Customer replied: "Thanks, please confirm when graphs are back".
kevin: Backfill completed at 1801237670. Verified sample req_id r_9a8b7c is now present in the metrics store. Re-ran the UI query and graph shows ~120k tokens for region=eu-west + model=lama-v2 + version=v1.3.
sara: Confirmed with customer, they see correct graphs now. Closing P1. :white_check_mark: 
kevin: I'll follow up with a postmortem and a test to ensure aliased events keep explicit version fields.
matt: Adding to release notes: analytics-ingest: preserve model_version when model_alias present; added backfill for 2026-03-15 ingestion window.
infra-bot: Incident closed.
